messages:
maya: Final copy pass for tri-mode landing (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Need hero lines, CTAs, webinar hooks, benchmark blurb, and lead routing. Can we ship today?

devon: Hero options: A) 'Fast inference, predictable cost.' B) 'One API. Any deployment. Your controls.' C) 'Production-grade inference, out of the box.'

sam: Prefer B for Private, A for Hosted, C for Dedicated. Bench blurb: 'p95 <300ms on common open models; 30-45% unit cost reduction with batching+KV cache in internal tests.'

lee: CTAs: Hosted - 'Try Hosted API 9 free credits'; Dedicated - 'Reserve Dedicated'; Private - 'Contact sales for Private deployment'. Visual notes: padlock for Private, benchmark chart near Dedicated.

nilesh: Routing: hidden field mode_interest captures which CTA. Hosted -> marketing nurture; Dedicated/Private -> AE queue. Add benchmark_event_rsvp tag for webinar signups.

ops-bot: benchmark-note: internal lab on g4dn-equivalent; 10k requests; p95 reported. Also: add UTM params utm_source=site utm_campaign=tri-mode-launch.

maya: Great. Devon will finalize microcopy & push doc link, Lee will prepare two hero mockups, Nilesh will confirm HubSpot mapping and test. Meeting if blockers at 4pm.
